expected: Pressing on an anchor calls currentTarget.setPointerCapture(1) exactly once, and the subsequent move + up still commits one onPathEdit carrying the moved anchor (x 0.26, y 0.55).
actual: AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times at VectorPathOverlay.test.ts:993 — startEditDrag opens the anchor drag state but never captures the pointer.
semanticAssessment: The named target executed inside its own test body and failed on the planned assertion (no setPointerCapture at a drag press), not on a load, import, collection or fixture fault. The other three capture/release cases fail the same way (anchor press, handle press, finish release, cancel release). The two guard cases (insert-click takes no capture; a lost pointer is not released) pass at HEAD by construction because HEAD makes no capture call at all — they exist to stop over-capture and over-release once the capture lands. 48 of the 52 tests pass, so the suite collected and ran normally.
